common_name: Fig-Breeding Oriental Sophophora Fly (Longitudinal Sex-Comb Tooth Array)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength of the longitudinal sex-comb tooth array at the 2.1 µm detail scale

paleobiology.note: All three names are extant Holocene species. The predecessor/successor order is the project chronoseries, not a claim that eugracilis is a stratigraphic ancestor of ficusphila.

state_variables.u: activator (tooth-ridge pigment precursor) concentration, dimensionless Schnakenberg units
state_variables.domain: flat periodic patch of tarsal epithelium, Lx = 8 λ_c, Ly = 6 λ_c

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg (1979): R_u = a - u + u^2 v, R_v = b - u^2 v
equations.pde: ∂_t u = D_u ∇²u + R_u(u,v); ∂_t v = D_v ∇²v + R_v(u,v)
equations.dispersion: σ(k) = largest real eigenvalue of J - k^2 diag(D_u, D_v)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)

boundary_conditions.justification: The detail patch is an interior piece of the tarsomere, far from the joint on the scale of one 2.072 µm ridge. No-flux edges would pin a boundary layer that this tier does not resolve.

parameters.note: D_u and D_v are derived in the script so that k_c equals 2π/2.072 µm⁻¹ at r=20. They are not the alpha_scale/beta_offset pair of slot 2821.

empirical_claims.claim: Longitudinal sex combs, oriented on the proximo-distal leg axis, evolved more than once. In some lineages a transverse bristle row rotates about 90 degrees; in others the bristles are born already longitudinal.
Sex-specific bristle traits, including sex combs, are spatially restricted by HOX-dependent doublesex expression.
A homogeneous morphogen field can become unstable at a finite critical wavenumber k_c.
The 2.072 µm figure is the assigned detail-tier wavelength for this slot. It is not a tooth spacing measured in Tanaka et al. (2009) or Kopp (2011).
At this tier the focal comb is assigned linear density 1, the reduced-tooth predecessor 2/3, and the picture-wing successor 1/2, which sets λ = 2.072, 3.108 and 4.144 µm through D_u only.

specimen_image.license_note: Repository species-gallery asset used because Wikimedia Commons returned no bitmap for Drosophila ficusphila on 2026-10-27. Stylized sepia spiral plate, not an SEM.
